neighbours.label: the digit token '0' ending a three-digit model number (A38⟦0⟧, R58⟦0⟧); other final digits stay quiet
fire: The carrier retired its last Airbus A340 after twenty years of service.
We replaced the old rack with an HP ProLiant DL380 last month.
Her first motorcycle was a Honda CB350 with a cracked seat.
The lab runs its simulations on a Dell PowerEdge R740 in the basement.
He restored a Volvo 240 that had sat in a barn for years.
Pilots say the Boeing 720 was a handful in a crosswind.
The studio mixes on a Yamaha DX580 that nobody else wanted.
The photographer still shoots with a Nikon D850 on every trip.
quiet: The airline sold its oldest Airbus A319 to a charter firm.
We swapped the old rack for an HP ProLiant DL385 in the spring.
Her first motorcycle was a Honda CB125 with a torn seat.
The cluster runs on a Dell PowerEdge R815 in the cellar.
He rebuilt a Volvo 242 that had been left in a field.
Pilots say the Boeing 727 was noisy on takeoff.
The studio records on a Yamaha DX7 that everybody wanted.
The photographer still travels with a Nikon D4 on every assignment.

notes: Card: 30 of the top 32 peak on '0' (A380, DL580, .380). Probes: A380 0.80, A350 0.56, R580 0.42, 280 0.31, 380 0.23, 1380 0.20, so it is the final '0' of a three-digit number, strongest in letter+digit model names. Near misses are model numbers ending in another digit.
